$comment: Acceptance-test video IR. deck-video pipeline, narrating a subset of the capability deck. Scene roles follow the brand storyline arc: hook, problem, approach, proof, outcome, call-to-action.

scenes.vo: A retail plan is agreed in a boardroom. It is executed by one person, standing in one store, on a Tuesday afternoon.
scenes.caption: A retail plan is agreed in a boardroom. It is executed by one person, standing in one store, on a Tuesday afternoon.

scenes.vo: Most programmes do not fail on strategy. They fail on three things. Field staff turn over before they are trained. Compliance is self-reported, so nobody can check it. And the report arrives a month after the sale was lost.
scenes.caption: Most programmes do not fail on strategy. They fail on three things.

scenes.vo: Across the programmes we have inherited, field attrition ran at sixty two percent. Self-reported compliance overstated the audited figure by three and a half times. And it took thirty one days for a field event to reach the brand.
scenes.caption: Across the programmes we have inherited, attrition ran at sixty two percent.

scenes.vo: So we treat the person in the store as the product. Four steps, from in-app learning through field shadowing and classroom sessions, to a certification that is re-earned every quarter.
scenes.caption: We treat the person in the store as the product.

scenes.vo: And every claim the programme makes is traceable. Captured in the field with a geo-stamp, verified automatically, scored against the planogram, and raised the same day it happens.
scenes.caption: Every claim the programme makes is traceable.

scenes.vo: The result is not that people got better. Self-reported compliance barely moved. Audited compliance rose from sixty one to ninety two percent, because the gap between the two stopped being invisible.
scenes.caption: Audited compliance rose from sixty one to ninety two percent.

scenes.vo: That model runs today across four thousand two hundred general trade stores, six hundred and eighty modern trade doors, and two thousand nine hundred telecom outlets.
scenes.caption: Live today across more than seven thousand stores.

scenes.vo: Pick one territory and one metric. We will run it for a quarter, against your current baseline.
scenes.caption: Pick one territory and one metric.
